text: G1b draws for K04 by d3_sample_packet.py (files d3_draw_K04_209, _309, _409, _509, _609, _709; ten lines each, seed 20261016 plus the offset; headers confirm 100, 100, 100, 100, 100 and 84 instantiate lines). In each draw the quotes agree with the ruling the how and labels would get under G56; no drawn line is unsupported in G1b's sense. But the draws show three kinds the census must keep apart: lines that play the community's own jokes, lore, catchphrases or ideology in canvas talk (CU: Rainbow6, kanye, mysterydungeon, btc and most others), the nation claimed beyond the flag (NA: greece, sweden, austria), a colour faith (CO: theblackvoid; cubers defecting from the blue corner); and lines whose concepts show only the community's subject as the mark's picture or name (stargate, yogscast, ultrahardcore, cmu, penguins, hoodr), which G56 sends to P02. As in D3a-51, every packet is read whole in windows of 25 lines, so the draws decide nothing on their own. Next: windows i209_000 and i209_025

G56's readings 1 to 4, stated while reading K04's instantiate window i209_000 (25 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (1) CU is shown where members play, use or explain the community's own jokes, lore, catchphrases or idiom in canvas talk: a pun, chant, oath, salute or slogan, the in-jokes on the mark explained to a newcomer, or the canvas told in the subject's terms (2007scape c0505, c0858 to c0861; 49ers c0042; DatBoi c0013; FederationPlace c0008; Bravenewbies c0002). A concept that only chooses, proposes, places or gives the reason for the picture, the sub's emblem, running theme, character or lore symbol as the mark's content, shows P02 and not K04 (AvoArmy c0076; ElderScrolls c0017, c0019, c0022). (2) Belonging or kinship to a body that is not a nation or region (a school, a team, a fandom, sister subs), voiced through the canvas, is a form the statement does not name: it names belonging and kin only for the nation, and for the sub its quarrel, lore, jokes and ideology. Such a line is a paired elaboration (BE) where a second room's line shows it, and a particular where only one does (DCFU c0017, c0025, paired with auburn c0028, read whole in the draw). A region counts as the nation, as T3-180's words 'the nation or region' hold (DevonUK c0014). (3) A canvas fight told in a fandom's lore or a nation's history is FT (CKCrusaders c0085, a crusade on Turkey's flag; Dominican c0057, European imperialists again). A community's identity against a rival site is CU and QU (4chan c0042, c0265); a brand rivalry joke is CU and QU (AyyMD c0016). A francophone community saying it is not French, beside the French flag in its logo, argues belonging beyond the flag (NA: CryptoFR c0010). (4) The community's talk with no tie to the canvas does not show K04 (Braveryjerk c0001, a CSS lent to another sub for the day). Next: K04-inst-spec-1.txt

G56's readings 5 and 6, stated while reading K04's instantiate window i209_025 (25 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (5) A fandom's idiom that frames the canvas fight (a call, a defence or a closing boast told in its lore) is FT as well as CU (FloydVsVoid c0028; HomestarRunner c0145). A national figure or a colonial past named for the canvas defence or expansion is NA and FT (Peru c0063; PlaceNL c0141, c0142). A fandom's quarrel between rival favourites, each with its own fans, carried into the defence of a sign is CU and QU (OneTrueEmilia c0017). (6) A colour faith, or an order, that members trace to a body from before the canvas, such as the Button's colours and its knights, is marked BT beside its form (PurplePixels c0050, c0165, CO; AprilKnights c0044, c0097, CU, whose tag row in K04-tags-1.txt gains BT). G56's census rule called the colour faith one that no room held before the canvas; BT counts the lines that show otherwise, for the status ruling. A visitor from a kin colour sub who hails the faith is VE (GreenEmpire c0006). Lore played in the April Fools makeover of the subreddit is K01's, and a wish for the logo is P02's, so GuildWars2's line does not show K04 (c0036, c0128, c0078, c0089). A member who gives school spirit as a reason for the work is BE (Northwestern c0039, paired with auburn c0028). Next: K04-inst-spec-2.txt, and BT added to AprilKnights-039 in K04-tags-1.txt

G56's reading 7, stated while reading K04's instantiate window i209_050 (25 lines), before its rows are written; not an amendment. A conference of schools, or a fandom's sister subs, invoked as the tie that keeps each other's logos and holds back attacks is BE (TheB1G c0018, c0027, c0030, paired with DCFU c0017; WisconsinBadgers c0029, whose line is a specification for the fight song's words in c0001, CU, and is marked BE too). A faith in a canvas object or in every colour, preached or set against an agreement, is CO (SquareSpiral c0007, c0174; ainbowroad c0241, c1793). A political ideology professed with its colour is CU and CO (TheFarLeftSide c0173, c0268, c0366; a visiting sub's greeting in c0072 is VE). A school's honour code or league standing turned on a canvas act is CU (aggies c0138; Temple c0106). Visitors who explain a neighbour's national history, or their own fandom's lore for a fight, are VE (RelientK c0014, c0020, NA; achievement_hunter c0033, CU and FT). The cast's characters or the stream's jokes added to the picture show P02 (achievement_hunter c0025, c0026, c0036; Summit1G c0035, c0037, c0038; reading 1). Next: K04-inst-spec-3.txt

G56's reading 8, stated while reading K04's instantiate window i209_075 (25 lines), before its rows are written; not an amendment. A joke in talk of the flag's design shows CU only where its words mark it as the community's own (the subject's names, terms or language); a joke the concepts do not tie to the community, beside talk of the flag's design, shows P02 (alberta c0010, c0013). Choosing which character to add, even in the fandom's word for a favourite, is P02 (araragi c0020, c0021). A community's cause argued as what its flag stands for is CU (asktransgender c0002, c0140), and national politics read in the canvas is NA (asktransgender c0166, with a jab at a rival sub, QU; bakchodi c0021, c0166, c0228). An old war between nations recalled in canvas talk is NA and QU (australia c0211; austria c0037; argentina c0191; albania c0064). A visitor who asks help in remembrance of a shared war, and a member who answers it as kin, show kin nations (NA, VE: australia c0363, c0364). A member's joy at being part of the family is BE (auburn c0028, paired with Northwestern c0039). Next: K04-inst-spec-4.txt
